newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador C.Bank chief, monetary council head named.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador C.Bank chief, monetary council head named.

text.p: Ecuador's government appointed economist and banker Daniel Carrera as president of the country's Monetary Council Sunday, completing the appointments for economic posts in the new administration, the government said Sunday.
The government also said it appointed Fidel Jaramilla to the post of manager of the central bank.
Together with Finance Minister Carlos Dualos, Jaramillo and Carrera will evaluate the economic program of the new government led by President Fabian Alarcon, which will be presented in a month.
The government said in a statement it appointed Mario Jaramillo education minister, Manuel Chiriboga agriculture minister and Roberto Wagner health minister.
"The remaining members of the cabinet will be appointed in coming hours," said the government statement.

President Alarcon was voted interim president by Congress earlier in the week after Congress ousted President Abdala Bucaram on the grounds of mental incapacity. Alarcon will lead the government until the middle of next year when new elections are held.
